<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>El Tratado Antártico</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Lato:ital,wght@0,300;0,400;0,700;0,900;1,300&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box;}
html,body{width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#02060c;font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;}
body{position:relative;}

/* ===== ESCENA (botella + fondo a pantalla completa) ===== */
.scene{
  position:absolute;inset:0;
  overflow:hidden;
  transition:transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
  z-index:1;
}
.scene-bg{
  position:absolute;inset:-3%;
  background:url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center center/cover no-repeat;
  background-color:#02060c;
  animation:floatBottle 16s ease-in-out infinite;
  will-change:transform;
}
@keyframes floatBottle{
  0%  {transform:scale(1.02) translate(0,0) rotate(0deg);}
  25% {transform:scale(1.03) translate(8px,-16px) rotate(0.4deg);}
  50% {transform:scale(1.02) translate(-4px,-24px) rotate(-0.3deg);}
  75% {transform:scale(1.03) translate(-8px,-12px) rotate(0.3deg);}
  100%{transform:scale(1.02) translate(0,0) rotate(0deg);}
}
.overlay{
  position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 45%, rgba(2,8,15,0) 30%, rgba(2,8,15,0.55) 100%);
}
canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;pointer-events:none;}

/* zona clickeable sobre la botella */
.bottle-hit{
  position:absolute;
  top:31%;left:53%;transform:translateX(-50%);
  width:14%;height:50%;
  background:transparent;border:none;outline:none;
  cursor:pointer;z-index:5;
}

/* ===== CARTEL "HACE CLIC" debajo de la botella ===== */
.hint{
  position:absolute;right:11%;top:55%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;
  text-align:left;pointer-events:none;z-index:6;
  transition:opacity 0.5s;
}
.hint-arrow{
  font-size:46px;color:#EAF7FF;line-height:1;
  animation:bounceX 1.6s ease-in-out infinite;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(127,219,255,0.9));
}
@keyframes bounceX{0%,100%{transform:translateX(0);}50%{transform:translateX(-12px);}}
.hint-text{
  color:#EAF7FF;font-size:16px;font-weight:300;letter-spacing:0.20em;
  text-transform:uppercase;line-height:1.5;font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;
  text-shadow:0 2px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.95),0 0 50px rgba(127,219,255,0.4);
  animation:fadeHint 2.8s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes fadeHint{0%,100%{opacity:0.7;}50%{opacity:1;}}

/* ===== PANEL DE TEXTO (se despliega al costado) ===== */
.message-panel{
  position:absolute;top:0;right:0;height:100%;
  width:42%;min-width:380px;max-width:640px;
  background:rgba(3,10,18,0.90);
  backdrop-filter:blur(14px);
  border-left:1px solid rgba(127,219,255,0.18);
  box-shadow:-30px 0 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.6);
  transform:translateX(105%);
  transition:transform 0.9s cubic-bezier(.22,.61,.36,1);
  overflow-y:auto;z-index:10;
}
body.open .message-panel{transform:translateX(0);}
body.open .scene{transform:translateX(-19%);}
body.open .hint{opacity:0;}

.message-panel,.message-panel *{font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;}
.message-inner{padding:48px 44px;position:relative;}
.msg-close{
  position:absolute;top:22px;right:26px;background:transparent;border:none;
  color:rgba(234,247,255,0.45);font-size:30px;cursor:pointer;line-height:1;
  transition:color 0.2s;font-family:'Lato',sans-serif;
}
.msg-close:hover{color:#7FDBFF;}
.msg-date{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.26em;color:#ffffff;opacity:1;
  text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:18px;font-weight:300;
}
.msg-title{
  font-size:25px;font-weight:900;color:#EAF7FF;margin-bottom:18px;
  letter-spacing:-0.01em;line-height:1.2;
}
.msg-subtitle{
  font-size:14px;font-weight:300;color:#EAF7FF;margin-bottom:22px;line-height:1.75;
  border-left:2px solid rgba(127,219,255,0.3);padding-left:18px;
}
.msg-divider{width:40px;height:1px;background:rgba(127,219,255,0.4);margin:0 0 26px;}
.msg-section{margin-bottom:22px;}
.msg-section-title{
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:0.12em;color:#7FDBFF;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700;
}
.msg-section-text{font-size:13.5px;color:#EAF7FF;line-height:1.75;font-weight:300;}
.msg-section-text ul{list-style:none;padding:0;margin-top:7px;}
.msg-section-text ul li{padding:3px 0 3px 16px;position:relative;}
.msg-section-text ul li::before{content:"\2022";position:absolute;left:0;color:#7FDBFF;}
.msg-seal{
  font-size:11px;letter-spacing:0.18em;color:#ffffff;opacity:1;text-transform:uppercase;
  margin-top:32px;padding-top:20px;border-top:1px solid rgba(127,219,255,0.18);font-weight:400;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="scene" id="scene">
  <div class="scene-bg"></div>
  <canvas id="c"></canvas>
  <div class="overlay"></div>
  <button class="bottle-hit" id="bottleHit" aria-label="Abrir mensaje"></button>
  <div class="hint" id="hint">
    <span class="hint-arrow">&#8592;</span>
    <div class="hint-text">Hac&eacute; clic para<br>descubrir el secreto</div>
  </div>
</div>

<aside class="message-panel" id="msgPanel">
  <div class="message-inner">
    <button class="msg-close" onclick="closeMsg()">&#10005;</button>
    <div class="msg-date">Washington, 1 de diciembre de 1959</div>
    <div class="msg-title">EL TRATADO ANT&Aacute;RTICO (1959)</div>
    <div class="msg-subtitle">El elemento central del Sistema Ant&aacute;rtico es el Tratado Ant&aacute;rtico, firmado en 1959 por doce pa&iacute;ses: Argentina, Australia, B&eacute;lgica, Chile, Francia, Jap&oacute;n, Nueva Zelanda, Noruega, Sud&aacute;frica, la Uni&oacute;n Sovi&eacute;tica, el Reino Unido y los Estados Unidos. El tratado entr&oacute; en vigor el 23 de junio de 1961.</div>
    <div class="msg-divider"></div>
    <div class="msg-section">
      <div class="msg-section-title">A &middot; Uso pac&iacute;fico</div>
      <div class="msg-section-text">La Ant&aacute;rtida solo puede utilizarse con fines pac&iacute;ficos. Se proh&iacute;ben:<ul><li>Las bases militares con fines ofensivos.</li><li>Las pruebas de armas.</li><li>Las maniobras b&eacute;licas.</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <div class="msg-section">
      <div class="msg-section-title">B &middot; Libertad de investigaci&oacute;n cient&iacute;fica</div>
      <div class="msg-section-text">Los pa&iacute;ses cooperan cient&iacute;ficamente y comparten informaci&oacute;n, observaciones y resultados de investigaci&oacute;n.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="msg-section">
      <div class="msg-section-title">C &middot; Congelamiento de los reclamos territoriales</div>
      <div class="msg-section-text"><ul><li>Ning&uacute;n pa&iacute;s pierde sus reclamos territoriales.</li><li>Los reclamos no pueden ampliarse ni hacerse valer mediante el uso de la fuerza.</li><li>No se reconocen nuevos reclamos mientras el Tratado permanezca vigente.</li></ul></div>
    </div>
    <div class="msg-section">
      <div class="msg-section-title">D &middot; Inspecci&oacute;n y transparencia</div>
      <div class="msg-section-text">Las estaciones e instalaciones pueden ser inspeccionadas por observadores internacionales para garantizar el cumplimiento del Tratado.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="msg-section">
      <div class="msg-section-title">E &middot; Protecci&oacute;n ambiental</div>
      <div class="msg-section-text">El Protocolo de Madrid (1991) declar&oacute; a la Ant&aacute;rtida una reserva natural dedicada a la paz y a la ciencia, y prohibi&oacute; la explotaci&oacute;n minera con fines comerciales.</div>
    </div>
    <div class="msg-seal">Documento preservado &mdash; Sistema Ant&aacute;rtico Internacional</div>
  </div>
</aside>

<script>
var canvas=document.getElementById('c');
var ctx=canvas.getContext('2d');
var W,H,t=0;
function resize(){W=canvas.width=window.innerWidth;H=canvas.height=window.innerHeight;}
resize();window.addEventListener('resize',resize);

var bubbles=[];
function seed(){
  bubbles=[];
  var n=Math.round(W*H/14000);
  for(var i=0;i<n;i++){
    bubbles.push({x:Math.random()*W,y:Math.random()*H,r:Math.random()*4+0.6,
      speed:Math.random()*0.9+0.15,drift:Math.random()*0.7-0.35,
      alpha:Math.random()*0.25+0.04,wobble:Math.random()*6.28,twinkle:Math.random()*6.28});
  }
}
seed();window.addEventListener('resize',seed);

function draw(){
  t+=0.016;ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);
  bubbles.forEach(function(b){
    b.y-=b.speed;b.x+=Math.sin(t*0.45+b.wobble)*b.drift;
    if(b.y<-8){b.y=H+8;b.x=Math.random()*W;}
    if(b.x<0)b.x=W;if(b.x>W)b.x=0;
    var pulse=Math.sin(t*1.1+b.twinkle)*0.18+0.82;
    var g=ctx.createRadialGradient(b.x-b.r*0.35,b.y-b.r*0.35,0,b.x,b.y,b.r);
    g.addColorStop(0,'rgba(210,240,255,'+(b.alpha*2.2*pulse)+')');
    g.addColorStop(0.45,'rgba(110,180,220,'+(b.alpha*0.7*pulse)+')');
    g.addColorStop(1,'rgba(30,90,150,'+(b.alpha*0.08)+')');
    ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(b.x,b.y,b.r,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(180,220,250,'+(b.alpha*0.7*pulse)+')';ctx.lineWidth=0.4;ctx.stroke();
  });
  requestAnimationFrame(draw);
}
draw();

var body=document.body;
document.getElementById('bottleHit').addEventListener('click',function(){body.classList.add('open');});
function closeMsg(){body.classList.remove('open');}
window.closeMsg=closeMsg;
</script>
</body>
</html>
